content:
The Lean Community has an admin team, whose duties are described on the team's web page. Our organization bylaws dictate that the members of the admin team are elected annually by members of all the teams. Members of the admin team may be re-elected.

This year, after serving on the team since its inception, @Rob Lewis has asked to step down. The teams have nominated and approved @Eric Wieser to replace him, and Eric was agreed to serve. The remaining members of the team are unchanged.

Rob, thanks for your service! Welcome, Eric!
